rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for the euro currency unit.

example.english: One euro can't get you much money nowadays.
example.traditional: 一歐元而家換唔到好多錢。
example.jyutping: jat1 au1 jyun4 ji4 gaa1 wun6 m4 dou2 hou2 do1 cin2

rows.note: A speaker uses this colloquial alternative, especially in casual conversation.

example.english: I only have one euro on me.
example.jyutping: ngo5 san1 soeng6 zing6 hai6 dak1 jat1 au1 lo4
